text: Director Eriana Vos serves as Intelligence Chief of the PMC Syndicate (Corporate Spy Network) within the pmc_syndicate faction.
Orchestrated covert operations to destabilize Union holdings; conducted hostile takeovers; secretly deals with the Shadow Syndicate (suspected sabotage).
Distinct from Lyra Voss, Lirian Vael-Torin (aka "Lirian Vos"), and Rhaegon Torr-Kai (aka "Rhaegon Voss"). PMC leadership: CEO/Military Commander Vailen Rix.
Information Warfare Specialist, Prefers Subtle Manipulation Over Direct Conflict.
